build_agent_pipeline: build an AgentPipeline from a list of GenericAgent instances to chain sequential processing stages
check_pipeline_types: check that consecutive agents in an AgentPipeline have matching source_type and target_type
build_tree_agent_pipeline: build a TreeAgentPipeline with a DAG of agents and optional output-index argument
push_segment_pipeline: push a Segment through an AgentPipeline passing it sequentially through each module
pop_segment_pipeline: pop the final Segment output from the last module in an AgentPipeline
